method: Chromium against production build, real disposable SQLite and disk storage. Visibility state was injected at the browser API boundary; network offline and delayed real requests tested failures. Test scripts were temporary.
limitations: Mobile viewport emulation, not physical devices.
External GLM and DeepSeek reviews did not start: OpenRouter API key unavailable.
No Docker install, S3, restore or production deployment in this scoped review.

findings.title: Question falsely marked sent after access changes
findings.trigger: Enable an NDA requirement while an investor has a document question open. The POST follows an access redirect to HTML with HTTP 200; the draft was cleared and Sent displayed although SQLite contained no message.
findings.fix: Require the question endpoint’s JSON conversation ID before acknowledging success. Keep the draft and explain the access change.
findings.evidence: Before: sent=1, stored=0, draft gone. After: sent=0, stored=0, full draft retained.
findings.origin: Present in the source snapshot at the start of this review; historical introduction not assigned.

findings.title: Question draft follows navigation to a different document
findings.trigger: Draft a question on Overview, close it, and use Next file. The reused page retained the question while submitting it against Financial model.
findings.fix: Remount viewer children when the file or investor session changes, resetting file-local UI state.
findings.evidence: Next document now opens an empty question; PDF resume and successful posting also checked.
findings.origin: Present in the source snapshot at the start of this review; historical introduction not assigned.

findings.title: Reopening a question silently changes its page
findings.trigger: Draft on page 1, close the dialog, navigate to page 3, and reopen. The old text was silently relabelled as a page 3 question.
findings.fix: Preserve the original page while a nonempty draft exists.
findings.evidence: A real 5,000-character submission was stored once for Overview page 1, after navigating to page 3.
findings.origin: Present in the source snapshot at the start of this review; historical introduction not assigned.

findings.title: Video shortcuts override native buttons and sliders
findings.trigger: Space on Mute started playback instead of toggling mute. ArrowLeft on Volume sought from 7 to 2 seconds.
findings.fix: Leave native input keys and button activation alone; ignore modified shortcuts.
findings.evidence: Space muted while paused; ArrowLeft reduced volume from 1 to 0.95 while time stayed at 7; seek slider also worked.
findings.origin: Present in the source snapshot at the start of this review; historical introduction not assigned.

findings.title: Video seek track collapses on small phones
findings.trigger: At a 320 px viewport, fixed-width toolbar controls squeezed the seek input to zero width.
findings.fix: Wrap the toolbar and give the seek slider a full-width row on phones.
findings.evidence: 320 px screenshot: track width 264 px, no horizontal page overflow. Also checked 390 and 1440 px.
findings.origin: Present in the source snapshot at the start of this review; historical introduction not assigned.

findings.title: Final visible reading interval is lost on tab hide
findings.trigger: Visibility changes to hidden before the event handler runs. Checking the new visibility inside account() discarded the interval that had just been read.
findings.fix: Track the previous visibility, account before changing it, flush on hide, and reset timing on page show.
findings.evidence: Before: 0 ms. After: 1,587 ms credited. A 1,200 ms hidden interval added nothing; resumed visible time added about 600 ms.
findings.origin: Present in the source snapshot at the start of this review; historical introduction not assigned.

findings.title: Authentication forms remain disabled after network failure
findings.trigger: Disconnect before signing in, setting a password, or changing a password. An unhandled fetch rejection left busy=true and no recovery message.
findings.fix: Catch failures, clear busy in finally, retain entered values, and handle sign-out failures.
findings.evidence: All three forms became enabled with an error. Reconnecting completed sign-in, invitation setup and password change without a reload. Sign-out and one-time reset-link consumption checked.
findings.origin: Present in the source snapshot at the start of this review; historical introduction not assigned.

findings.title: Password-reset HTTP errors report successful delivery
findings.trigger: Trigger the real request-password-reset rate limit. The page ignored HTTP 429 and said a reset link had been sent.
findings.fix: Only show reset success for an OK response; render HTTP and connection failures in the form.
findings.evidence: Real HTTP 429 now shows Too many attempts, retains the email, and shows no sent confirmation.
findings.origin: Present in the source snapshot at the start of this review; historical introduction not assigned.

findings.title: Unchanged NDA is described as changed on repeat entry
findings.trigger: Clear the session and reenter after accepting the current NDA. Any earlier acceptance was treated as proof of a new version.
findings.fix: Read the accepted NDA version ID and compare it with the current version.
findings.evidence: Same version: no changed warning. Replacement version: warning and HTTP 303 file gate; accepting restores HTTP 200. Unauthenticated file request remains HTTP 401.
findings.origin: Present in the source snapshot at the start of this review; historical introduction not assigned.

findings.title: Sharing-link edits made during save are discarded
findings.trigger: With a slow save request, inputs remained editable after the request body had been captured. A later edit appeared accepted but vanished when the save completed.
findings.fix: Disable the form fieldset while saving, alongside the existing footer and dismissal guards.
findings.evidence: Held then continued a real update_link request: input disabled while pending, operation completed normally.
findings.origin: Present in the source snapshot at the start of this review; historical introduction not assigned.

findings.title: Observer is offered editable retention controls
findings.trigger: An observer opening an active room fell into the frozen-room retention branch and saw a form for an operation their role cannot perform.
findings.fix: Only render retention editing for frozen rooms and a writable member role.
findings.evidence: Observer retention heading count changed from 1 to 0. Existing server authorization was already enforcing this restriction.
findings.origin: Present in the source snapshot at the start of this review; historical introduction not assigned.

findings.title: Pending destructive action can appear cancelled
findings.trigger: Start freezing a room, then click Cancel while its request is pending. The dialog closed, but the real freeze still completed.
findings.fix: Disable Cancel and prevent closing the confirmation while busy; guard duplicate starts and submissions.
findings.evidence: During a delayed real freeze request, Cancel was disabled and Escape kept the dialog visible. Releasing the request froze the disposable room.
findings.origin: Present in the source snapshot at the start of this review; historical introduction not assigned.

findings.title: PDF tools opened from a menu lose return focus
findings.trigger: Open Page thumbnails from Reader options, then close tools. Focus was returned to a menu item removed from the DOM, leaving BODY active.
findings.fix: Capture the stable Reader options trigger when tools are opened from its menu.
findings.evidence: Before active element BODY; after BUTTON with aria-label Reader options.
findings.origin: Present in the source snapshot at the start of this review; historical introduction not assigned.
